definitions.short: Achimaats , the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H290. Achimaats אֲחִימַ֫עַץ proper name, masculine ( my brother is wrath ) 1 son of Zadok 2Sam 15:27 , 36 ; 17:17 , 20 ; 18:19 , 22 , 23 , 27 , 28 , 29 ; 1 Chronicles 5:34 ( אֲחִימָ֑עַץ v. 1Chr 6:35 ; 6:38 ; perhaps also 1Kin 4:15 (son-in-law of Solomon) 2 אֲחִימָ֑עַץ , father-in-law of Saul 1Sam 14:50 . מעץ (√ of following; perhaps = be wrathful , compare Arabic be enraged ; compare also proper name, masculine אֲחִימַעַץ , above).

occurrences.englishText: The name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the captain of his army was Abner the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.
The king said also to Zadok the priest, “Aren’t you a seer? Return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz your son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.
Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz, Zadok’s son, and Jonathan, Abiathar’s son. Send to me everything that you shall hear by them.”
Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En Rogel; and a female servant used to go and tell them; and they went and told king David. For they might not be seen to come into the city.
Absalom’s servants came to the woman to the house; and they said, “Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?”
Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said, “Let me now run and carry the king news, how Yahweh has avenged him of his enemies.”
Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said yet again to Joab, “But come what may, please let me also run after the Cushite.”
“But come what may,” he said, “I will run.”
The watchman said, “I think the running of the first one is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok.”

Ahimaaz called, and said to the king, “All is well.” He bowed himself before the king with his face to the earth, and said, “Blessed is Yahweh your God, who has delivered up the men who lifted up their hand against my lord the king!”
The king said, “Is it well with the young man Absalom?”
Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon as wife);
the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
